rationale: One source-role rule and one tokenizer replace mixed historical conventions.
Substantive prose, block quotations, available notes and map captions are counted; navigation, note calls and source credits are not.
All five maps remain source evidence. Graphic internals are excluded from prose density; the page129 name list is a numbered map key rather than a separate analytic table.
The decision was made by source role before using the total, with no candidate quantities or desired density result.

The full page geometry and ownership are verified mechanically. A separate fresh-context reviewer checked all five maps and all17 chapter-opening top regions, and accepted this explicit operational denominator.
Excluding chapter display headings is an explicit navigation-versus-prose measurement choice, not exclusion of headings or maps from semantic eligibility.
reviewed_material: Source-map visual checks3,127,129,225,345 by source-only team
repeatability: Root independently reran the final code and reports byte-identical measurement output and rejection of a tampered manifest before output creation.
invocation: python3 scripts/measure_source_density.py --source SOURCE.pdf --manifest chunk-manifest.json --page-map page-map.json --private-dir PRIVATE_WORK_DIRECTORY --output source-density-measurement.json
limits: This is an exact operational text-density denominator, not the unique linguistic word count. PDF whitespace/possessives retain their extraction convention. No change to source subject eligibility, benchmark identity, policy or historical counts is made.
approval_is_not: Study-wide registration, benchmark selection, retrospective recalculation or candidate result transfer.
